touches.text: A line states the intention (the build target) in plain words: what it is and why. Every new input, answered question or measurement is read for how it changes or elaborates an intention or a why. That meaning is folded in; the words and the history that carried it are left out. Why? Because when we left the history in, it was much easier to get lost in THE SPECIFICS OF WHAT WAS SAID rather than what was meant. Whys are used when ajudicating conflicts at the level before asking the operator.

An artifact is present tense or past tense, never both. Present tense is rewritten whole and points at its provenance; past tense is append-only, opened when needed, and read cold only through a compiled face (state, the latest slate). WHY: what a cold reader loads at an address should be what is true now.
A dated aside (retired, formerly, a date in parentheses) in a present-tense artifact is history in the wrong place, and reads red. -akiendelllinux_cc_0

Ideas and questions are not tickets. An idea is a note that leads to an intention, and stops mattering once the intention is set down. A question exists only to deduce the why: once answered, what matters is the answer and the why, and nothing else.

Skills (skills/: cairnhelp, challenge, chart, commit, intent, sorted, ...) are Claude Code's. The deterministic parts move out of markdown into CC device verbs: a skill's OS-side work runs as a script, and CC's shim processes the result and injects it into the session. WHY: every habit captured that way is one CC no longer spends inference on, so CC gets faster; a first charting pass done in deterministic Python with no LLM until after saved about 90% of tokens, measured in real use.

Owns the Claude Code hooks: mail check, the turn-shape and ask scans, the gates on record writes and deletes. Anything that adapts CC specifically to Cairn goes in the CC device, and every one of CC's scripts lives here.

A ticket's plan carries only what a door can check. A decision line's by (free prose on every ticket) is not checked and not kept: the cast door checks writes_to and reads, and by goes. Who authored a line is not tracked, except on a gate-pass certificate. WHY: tickets moved from prose to JSON so their contents can be checked; a field no door checks is prose. - CC

Everything expressed here (names, concepts, implementations) is what we keep. Where the code still says otherwise, the code changes. Why? Because the code is farther removed from Akien's brain than the words are. They're the translation medium.

artifact: the one door a record of truth changes through, and the journal of who came through it (hash-chained, caller read from the kernel). WHY: errors are permanent in records of truth (Law 7), and the journal is what shows a record moved by hand. USERS: everyone who writes a record.
